messages.content: 計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。

function.name: statistics_calculate_p_value
function.description: Calculate the p-value for a t-test on a single sample from a population. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

sample_mean.description: The mean of the sample data. This is a float type value.

population_mean.description: The mean of the population data. This is a float type value.

sample_std_dev.description: The standard deviation of the sample data. This is a float type value.

sample_size.description: The size of the sample data.

two_tailed.description: Whether the test is two-tailed. If not provided, default is true.

message.reasoning: The user says: "計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。" They want to calculate something about hypothesis testing. They mention sample mean 98.2, sample std dev 1.4, sample size 40, null hypothesis population mean 98.6. They ask: "計算...的標準差" maybe they want the standard error? Or they want the p-value? The phrase "零假設檢定的標準差" might refer to the standard error of the mean under null? Actually "零假設檢定的標準差" could be "standard deviation for the null hypothesis test" which is the standard error of the sample mean: sigma/sqrt(n). But they gave sample std dev 1.4, but for null hypothesis we might use population std dev? But they didn't give population std dev. So likely they want the standard error: 1.4 / sqrt(40) = 1.4 / 6.3249 = 0.2215. But maybe they want the t-statistic? They might want to compute the t-statistic: (98.2 - 98.6) / (1.4 / sqrt(40)) = (-0.4) / 0.2215 = -1.805. Then maybe compute p-value. The tool provided calculates p-value for a t-test on a single sample from a population. So we can call that. We need to provide sample_mean=98.2, population_mean=98.6, sample_std_dev=1.4, sample_size=40. two_tailed default true. That will return p-value. So we should call the function.
